5_height-1622-1 for actual art” 003 - Hirotaka Tohyama4-2005.05.14 - 05.29 rhythm's "Project For Actual Art" presented the work of young Fukuoka painter Hirotaka Tohyama. The exhibition ran for 2 weeks. Tohyama's paintings were exhibited on the 1st and 2nd floors of artspace tetra where many people could observe and discuss his work.
